## biome-reads-the-gitignore-beside-its-config  (gotcha, verified)
Biome honours only the .gitignore beside its biome.json, so source/react-ui/.gitignore must repeat coverage/ and other generated paths the root .gitignore already lists.

## chip-row-fits-the-control-step-only-at-default-scales  (invariant, verified)
A field holding one chip row stays at the 32px control step only while size-xs + space-1 <= size-md - 2x border; reseeding the size or spacing scales makes a field with chips taller than an empty one.

## element-box-cannot-detect-own-padding  (gotcha, verified)
Comparing getBoundingClientRect().left of two elements passes regardless of their own inline padding; measure text position with a Range over the text instead.

## field-shell-control-must-be-direct-child  (gotcha, verified)
FieldShell's focus/open/invalid/disabled rules match only a direct non-slot child, so the control must not be wrapped, nothing inside may dim itself, and the leading/trailing slots are where an element can own its own state.

## fieldset-layout-is-shaped-by-the-legend  (rationale, verified)
FieldSet stays a plain block box with a padding-0 legend kept outside its flex-column body, because a native legend straddles the border and must never become a flex item.
